Name: Slime Hutch Water Spots
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
Vanilla Stardew Valley only recognizes four water troughs on specific tiles in slime hutches.

With this mod, custom slime hutch maps can place water troughs on any tile and they will be recognized by sprinklers, watering cans, and slimes alike.

An example mod is here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13779]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13779[/url]

[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
